text: 1. The applicant is a foreign citizen holding a foreign passport. He/She has excellent academic performance, good conduct, no criminal record and is in good health. 2. Possess an educational qualification equivalent to that of a senior high school graduate in China. 3. Applicants must achieve a score of over 180 in the new HSK Level 4 examination. 4. 12 of the Ministry of Education of China (2020), and provide relevant proof materials as per the school's admission requirements.
